text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $77k while Ethereum stalled at $2,426, suggesting caution among major holders despite a greed-dominated sentiment reading that has surged sharply over the past week. BTC dominance at 58.8% indicates capital is concentrating in the largest asset rather than rotating broadly into altcoins, even as smaller coins like SOL and BNB post modest gains. The $142B daily volume is healthy but the flat movement in both majors hints that bullish momentum is consolidating rather than accelerating.
